notes.title: The Re-Release is Here
notes.notes:
It's time. Destination Ares is re-releasing imminently and will be available for purchase soon.

The game is also being permanently reduced in price!  $19.99 / £19.99 / €19.99 -> $9.99 / £7.99 / €8.99
I will also be doing fewer sales these days, so I hope the reduced price makes up for that. Note that it might take a bit of time for the reduced price to propagate, but it should be there soon!

If you already own the game, you can get access to v1.1.0 [i]now[/i].


[h1]The New Destination Ares[/h1]

This update, v1.1.0, is significant in some fundamental parts of the code. It will break any in-progress runs.

[h2]Difficulty Options, for the less masochistic[/h2]
(Note: you still qualify for achievements while using these)

[h3]Resource Drain[/h3] - High ([i]default[/i]), Low

[h3]Crew Skill[/h3] - Untrained ([i]default[/i]), Skilled, Expert

[h3]Luck[/h3] - Even ([i]default[/i]), Improved

[h3]Minigame Toggle[/h3] (hotly demanded!)


[h2]System Construction & Salvage[/h2]

[h3]Build makeshift systems[i] in-flight[/i][/h3] when everything goes wrong! (Uses Science skill)

[h3]Break down old systems[/h3] for a few materials and parts! (Uses Mechanical skill)


[h2]New Events - what could go wrong?[/h2]

[h3]Free a crewmember[/h3] from the jaws [i]of the toilet's suction piece[/i]

[h3]Flood the atmos [i]with vaporized fuel[/i][/h3] when the air pressure is low

[h3]Turn an old corpse[/h3] into [i]something [/i]useful

[h3]Use solar arrays[/h3] as a [b]shield[/b] from micrometeoroids

[h3]Push a faulty fabricator[i] to consume everything onboard[/i][/h3] or die trying

[h3]Receive a [b]definitely [/b]innocent memo from GuideBot[/h3]


[h2]Fixes, Improvements, and Wildly Incoherent Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Started up minigame tutorial sooner
[*] Sped up minigame tutorial
[*] Made GuideBot harass you more often with snarky tips
[*] "Broken" tooltip text now red
[*] Overhauled event data structure internally
[*] Updated dev tools
[*] Unlocked all crew personalities from the beginning of the game; I apologize in advance if you roll a Chatty crewmember
[*] Fixed - Crew sometimes abandoned ship secretly when they were supposed to die, were listed as "Survived"
[*] "Pause" now slows the game to 1/500 speed, rather than perfect 0
[*] Added a second way to enter the path to the secret ending
[*] Some hard to press buttons are now, you know, easier to press
[*] Your hidden AI core more consistently consumes energy (every 10 seconds)
[*] Command skill is now more effective at preventing that passive energy drain, with the same diminishing returns
[*] Base crew resilience to stress is lowered, but more consistent
[*] Command skill increases stress resilience for all crew - so long as the crewmember(s) with the skill are capable of doing work
[*] (No changes to bonus minigame time from Command skill)
[*] Crew need to eat slightly more food and sleep slightly longer
[*] Special crew with increased resilience to needs (i.e., the "skilled engineer" and "famous scientist") eat a little less and sleep faster, in addition to less often
[*] The "wealthy doctor" gets a bonus point in Command
[*] Choosing "high quality system retrofits" does more, including handing out keywords
[*] Achievements should no longer unlock early
[/list]
[h2]Known Bug[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rarely dead crew continue moving for awhile, drifting about the ship and/or swinging arms (definitely won't fix)
[/list]

Let me know if you run into any new bugs, I might fix them again in another 4 or 5 years.

notes.title: Happy Launch! Here's a quick patch :)
notes.notes:
This update is mostly Quality of Life, bringing in a bunch of fixes and improvements to clean up the experience. ːredscientistː

Notably, crew will do off-task work more often. This should make the game demonstrably easier for less attentive AIs. (You still won't win. Git gud)

Patch:
[list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[*] Shortened how long it takes before the minigame tutorial turns on
[*] Slowed minigame tutorial down
[*] Clarified wording in minigame tutorial
[*] Improved clickability of minigame's "Return to Ship" button
[*] Destroyed systems are now more recognizable in their tooltips
[*] Increased how often crew will do off-task work. Should see more idle usage and repairs, especially with jobless crew

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[*] Fixed some special loss events getting ignored if the player resumes a run after exiting the game
[*] Fixed a couple achievement toggles (incl The Arean Trail. Grats if you got it free), though I suspect there's something else going on here
[*] Fixed typo in one of the Madness possibilities
[*] Fixed a bug in event management that had weird cascading effects
[*] Fixed Loss events getting overridden
[*] Fixed Loss events not spawning
[*] Made some tweaks that hopefully prevent a rare, hard-to-reproduce crash
[*] Fixed some blank crew chatter popping up
[/list]

---

On a personal note, I'm glad to see the full game is well-liked — especially after a rough Early Access.

Sales haven't been enough, though. No one is surprised that getting visibility is not my strong suit. It seems that I am going to have to begin work on other projects; I've been working for nothing for too many years.

Still, I reserve the right to come back and add to this game at any time ;)

-Pat

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26835721/66beda8a0bbbf4503fc5e0a73ec5873157f1511a.png[/img]

notes.title: June (+May) Update!!! v0.6.2
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26835721/f908c989c2a4fea49de435ec8376809014368591.png[/img]

As I promised last month, I packed in all kinds of goodies this month. Version 0.6.2 is a huge Quality of Life update, and I think you'll love it.

I was sure to put some oft requested features in this build:
[olist]
[*] [b]Highlighting resources on the HUD shows which systems consume or produce that resource. Great for learning what does what and how to get that random resource.[/b]

[*] [b]Controls for seeing underneath crew are available (hotkeys + HUD). You can toggle whether you want systems or crew on top, basically. Great for getting at that system under the corpses ;)[/b]

[*] [b]Game speed controls (pause/ play/ fastfoward) are now available on the HUD.[/b]
[/olist]

- - - -
Patch Notes

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[*] Added strained animation when system is both strained and in overdrive
[*] Added added injection effect to system tooltips when relevant
[*] Added a Standard event: "Puketastic"
[*] Added successful events as a reduction on event kindness
[*] Added living crew as a reduction on event kindness
[*] Now recolors system borders when you highlight resources. This should make it faster and easier to see what systems are involved with what resources
[*] Added CRT effects to main menu and ship building
[*] Added short animation to end of minigame
[*] Added game speed controls to the HUD
[*] Added controls for flipping between Crew or Systems on top
One step closer to release.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[*] Increased animation speed for engines and waste cannons while the injector's effect is active
[*] Changed a bunch of events that required engines to also allow waste cannons
[*] Changed Gyms into [Passive] systems, seeing as there's no reason to turn them off (for all the cruel AIs out there: you can still use ignore alerts if you want your crew to neither use nor repair gyms)
[*] Changed Toilets into [Passive] systems, for the same reason as Gyms
[*] Increased effect of lost progress on event kindness
[*] Increased effect of broken systems on event kindness
[*] Changed Use alerts so they can turn on systems (fewer clicks ftw)
[*] Overdrive now automatically turns off when system turns off
[*] Rephrased a sentence in the Tutorial (This will probably be moot after I replace the tutorial)
[*] Changed menu button colors (because I felt like it)
[*] Reduced volume of Generator audio
[*] Flipped direction of time loss penalty animation in minigame
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[*] Fixed overdriven systems being enabled and repaired on load
[*] Fixed negative momentum ending the game
[*] Fixed minor typo in opening story
[*] Fixed a Story event that was mislabelled as "Unknown"
[*] Fixed event kindness so it increases as you have fewer resources compared to storage capacity
[*] Fixed VFX from upgrading to Unity 5.6.1p1
[*] Fixed Overdrive commands so they always turn on systems, if not already on
[*] Fixed mouse pings on main menu
[*] Fixed an outline-related crash
[*] Fixed a crash from invalid crew heal attempts (and a few other potential causes)
[*] Fixed bug that gave out free Fireball achievement on some failed runs (oops)
[*] Fixed bug that delayed some system audios
[*] Fixed rare bug that prevented the minigame from ending
[/list]
- - - -

One step closer to release.

I never did finish those tools I was working on at the end of last month. [i]Soooooon[/i]

I'm setting an ambitious schedule for myself ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/553470/announcements/detail/1331226834650019790]see the last announcement[/url]). Let me know what to prioritize on my list.

[h1]Up next:[/h1] I plan to improve the controls and revamp the tutorial. Then on to more content! (And, of course, lots of little polish here and there)

Enjoy

-Pat

notes.title: Major Bugfix in the Works
notes.notes:
[h1]UPDATE[/h1]

Looks like the biggest source of crashes is a bug with the current build of the game engine (Unity). I'm going to play with workarounds and I'll move to a different version as soon as it's practical. I'm also still working on other bugs and features.

Rest assured, the occasional crashes are as frustrating to me as they are to you. There is good news: Destination Ares has a pretty sweet built-from-scratch autosave feature that means you can jump right back into your run where you left off, losing at most a few seconds or an event choice.

~ ~ ~

[h1]Original[/h1]

I'll be getting right to work on some of the new (big) bugs starting on Monday, after my exhibit at WGF is done. Hopefully I get through all the critical ones, and I'll push it out ASAP. Thanks for your patience, everyone!

notes.title: The Propulsion Update! (v0.5.7)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26835721/f952253ef51714089994685744f245fb88da7627.png[/img]

Time for another huge update!

I'm glad to be bringing this to you, especially since this build took longer than expected.

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[h1]Additions[/h1]
[*] Added Waste Cannons. Use that pent-up shit to fly
[*] Added Solar Sails. Harness the power of sunlight to (slowly, ever so slowly) propel yourself forward
[*] Added the [i]Folivora[/i], a slow-burn default ship built around new mechanics. Named after sloths, because it only goes fast when it poops
[*] Added triple window to helm extensions
[*] Added two types of space dust
[*] Added color aberration when time is dilated (both paused and sped up)
[*] Added "Right-click to customize" to relevant shipbuilding tooltips
[/list]
[list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[*] Turned down UI SFX
[*] Reorganized shipbuilding system menu into fewer categories
[*] Slowed background AI energy burn
[/list]
[list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[*] Improved minigame pings to be more responsive to player input
[*] Optimized tooltips (+30 fps, [i]seriously[/i])
[*] Stopped rotating stars with camera (reduces frame draw time by ~6ms)
[*] Fixed minigame crash particles
[*] Fixed flood event to pick a crew to pull the water to airlock
[*] Fixed crew color dropdowns so they reset properly
[*] Fixed loading custom ships in shipbuilding to kill repeat bug
[*] Fixed doors blocking crew mouseover
[/list]

~ ~ ~

On a personal note, I'm showcasing the game at UCSD's Winter Gamefest all weekend. If you happen to be in the San Diego area this weekend, swing by and say hi!

notes.title: The Energy Update (v0.5.5)!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26835721/0b3ac19c980cbed6294439d565c34cd8d0faa4bb.png[/img]

This is a big update. I've been working on it almost constantly for the last couple of weeks (ask my poor friends and family).

Some highlights:
[list]
[*] [i][b]Some systems now start offline.[/b][/i] Please turn on them on when you want to use them. I recommend your engines and your scrubber ASAP.
[*] New system: Generator. Spends fuel to get energy.
[*] New system: Solar Panel. Gets free energy, slowly.
[*] New system: Fuel Cell. Reverts fuel to materials; stores and makes energy slowly.
[*] Exposed more info for you to poke at and ponder. Event result tags, crew cause of death, customization values, and more, subtler things.
[*] Added a new new helpful event: the Emergency Supply Crate
[*] Made a few specific systems "smarter". Reactors cycle faster when energy isn't needed, hydroponics stay on (consuming energy) when there's no waste to grow into food (that's not how plants work, shh).
[*] The crew now sleeps a lot more. You can all feel less bad about using too many beds in your builds.
[/list]

I also
[list]
[*] Improved Electrolyser exchange rates
[*] Increased the minimum time between most events
[*] Cleaned up system animation timings
[*] 'Improved' tutorial (it's mostly the same)
[*] Made balance tweaks. (Spoilers)
[*] Fixed countless bugs. Literally an uncounted amount. At least four sheets of paper worth.
[/list]

Enjoy! Let me know what else needs fixed or you're looking forward to.

I'll be taking it slower this week. There will likely be another, smaller update with a few non-content changes in the next week or two, and then I'll work on another like this.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26835721/df128fde2330960c4a81b71909fb5e214e3bffea.png[/img]

notes.title: Update! New Event, Major Bugfixes, and More!
notes.notes:
I've pushed out an awesome update. For those of you who own the game, you'll have likely already downloaded it by the time you read this.

Don't worry, this update won't break any saves.

Let's go over what's new and different. [i]I'll skip a few minor fixes and changes to keep it short.[/i]


[h1]New Stuff[/h1]

I've added the [b][fated][/b] tag to event options. This tag means there's only one possible result from an option. [spoiler]That can happen whenever there's [i]always[/i] only one result, or also when the other possibilities are somehow eliminated because of your crew, ship, or resources. Additionally, [fated] options will skip minigames.[/spoiler]

I've added FIVE new songs from Kim, bringing the total to 17! They're awesome, and I feel they'll really flesh out the whole experience. Yes, these songs are included in the official soundtrack, but they hadn't made it into the game until now.

There's a new event! It may trigger when oxygen levels are high... be wary.

A few new sound effects made their way in, particularly in the minigame. Hopefully, the minigame feels more responsive and immersive. Let me know how it goes!


[h1]Changes[/h1]

The "Use" alert works indefinitely! Turn it on and watch the crew slave away. I did drop its priority so they'll remember to eat and sleep. Still, be sure to turn it off when you're done needing a system prioritized. Note: it will also turn itself off when the comms turns off.

The minigame instructions now explain the yellow arrows better, so you can figure out what's going on.

The minigame is harder. Penalties for messing up have increased, more walls have been added, and times have been shortened. I want to encourage studious, skilled play, rather than the haphazard zipping about that was so common with the lighter penalties. Let me know how it feels.

Rare events are now more likely. [spoiler]They didn't need to be that rare, especially when there aren't enough events to go around [b](yet)[/b].[/spoiler]

Events now have their own song based on type. They also interrupt your travel music, which should add to the atmosphere.

Events are less likely to stack on each other, one after another. This still happens occasionally, though, and I'll probably be improving it further in the next update.

The "Sickness" event isn't as punishing on success. Sorry for killing everyone all the time.

Electrolysers now spend less energy. Hopefully this makes them more viable, if still pretty niche. [spoiler]I'm playing with ship builds that focus on the Electrolyser. I may put one into the game down the line.[/spoiler]


[h1]Major Fixes[/h1]

My favorite fix: memorials now remember dead crew members that are no longer floating around the ship (i.e., spaced, stuffed in boxes, cannibalized...).

The "Spoiled Food" event now has real options.

And the big one: [b]failing events now works as intended: you won't randomly get better results[/b] (holy crap how did this one slip through the cracks so long?!). Better sharpen up your mine-dodging game.


Aaand, that's basically it for this update. Be sure to hit up the Steam forums with any feedback, tell your friends about the game, and (if you're enjoying the game so far) give it a glowing review!

-Pat


[h1]Next Update[/h1]

In addition to the laundry list of quality of life improvements I didn't get to yet:
[spoiler]
• I'm writing a new helpful event involving an overlooked crate of emergency supplies. It's almost done, and I think you'll like it.
• I'm also working on a new ship system design... Hopefully it will be ready in time.[/spoiler]

See you then.
